places.name: St. Barbara’s Church (UNESCO)
places.ai_summary: St. Barbara’s Church is a Gothic masterpiece and UNESCO World Heritage Site, renowned for its intricate architecture and stunning frescoes.
places.place_tip: Don’t miss the frescoes depicting miners’ lives.
places.address: St. Barbara’s Church, Kutná Hora, Czech Republic

places.ai_summary: The Sedlec Ossuary, or Bone Church, is a unique chapel adorned with human bones, symbolizing the fragility of life.
places.place_tip: Photography is allowed but be respectful.
places.address: Sedlec Ossuary, Kutná Hora, Czech Republic

places.name: Cathedral of the Assumption (UNESCO)
places.ai_summary: This cathedral is a UNESCO site, showcasing Baroque Gothic architecture and a rich history tied to the Sedlec Monastery.

places.address: Cathedral of the Assumption, Kutná Hora, Czech Republic

places.place_tip: Check out the medieval minting equipment.
places.address: Italian Court, Kutná Hora, Czech Republic
